title: 5 Lessons From a Weekend Vibe Coding Class As a Non-Technical Person - Business Insider
summary: The article discusses key insights from a vibe coding workshop, highlighting the importance of not fixating on a single app, understanding real user needs, and the shift in building bottlenecks to ideas and lived experiences. It also emphasizes learning through trial and error in a low-cost, fast-paced development environment.
